title: Develop an SEO search intent map for 'Cohort-based training software West Africa'
description:
Create a comprehensive search intent map and keyword hierarchy targeting educational organizations in West Africa looking for cohort-based training software.

Include:
1. Search Intent Matrix: Categorize 20 high-intent search terms (e.g. 'cohort training software Ghana', 'coding school LMS Nigeria', 'virtual boot camp platform Africa') into Informational, Commercial, and Navigational buckets.
2. Content Gap Analysis: Identify missing content on zedu.chat compared to traditional LMS platforms (stressing live cohort features vs passive video courses).

4. Value Hook: Highlight flat Naira pricing, unlimited cohorts on Pro, and AI that assists instructors.

Deliver a clean markdown plan in the attachment with zero hallucinated features.
rationale: Expands Zedu's organic visibility across West African search traffic, helping bootcamp directors discover affordable cohort-based software.
